name: AlphaFold2 Human Proteome Reverse Docking Benchmark
description: Evaluates reverse docking performance across AlphaFold2-predicted human proteome structures to assess docking methods at proteome scale.
general_score_metric: top-k hit rate (e.g., hit@1 / hit@5) and enrichment/ROC-AUC
reputation: A specialized benchmark gaining attention in structural bioinformatics for large-scale evaluation of docking methods against AlphaFold2-predicted structures, but not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Caveats include reliance on predicted (AlphaFold2) structures which may contain inaccuracies, scoring-function and protocol biases, potential target/ligand contamination, large proteome-scale heterogeneity, and this is a non-LLM, structure-based benchmark.
